sloka: प्रविश्य सीता बहुवृक्षषण्डां तां राक्षसेन्द्रस्य विहारभूमिम् ।सम्प्रेक्ष्य सञ्चिन्त्य च राजपुत्रौ परं विषादं समुपाजगाम ।। ६.४८.३७ ।।
transliteration: praviśya sītā bahuvṛkṣaṣaṇḍāṁ tāṁ rākṣasendrasya vihārabhūmim ।samprekṣya sañcintya ca rājaputrau paraṁ viṣādaṁ samupājagāma ।। 6.48.37 ।।

translations.english: Having entered the Rakshasa's pleasure garden which had many trees, Sita gave way to intense sorrow having keenly observed the king's sons. ।। इत्यार्षेवाल्मीकीयेश्रीमद्रामायणेआदिकाव्येयुद्धकाण्डेअष्टचत्वारिंशस्सर्गः ।। This is the end of the forty eighth sarga of Yuddha Kanda of the first epic the holy Ramayana composed by sage Valmiki.
